_comment: Floors gate on TESTABLE coverage — denominator excludes UI/lifecycle files per scripts/coverage-exclude.json. Overall floor 0.41 matches the 41.1% baseline established when the testable metric was introduced (no regression). Ratchet upward as real unit-testable coverage grows; do NOT raise the number by adding more paths to the exclude list. Per-module floors were already computed on files we unit-test directly, so they carry over unchanged.
